summary: Two demonstrated defects: the source easy Fahrenheit cake family is omitted, and supported moderate turkey/soup templates allow a perfect shortest-choice shortcut. The exact easy batch passes the tested math, grading and delivery checks; it does not exhibit that moderate shortcut. Package unchanged; no database writes.

source_analysis.skill: Translate Newton's cooling statement into a differential equation for temperature approaching a fixed ambient temperature from above.
reasoning_steps: Read which temperature belongs to the environment
Match the resulting equation to a single radio choice
invariants: Temperature decreases toward a fixed ambient value
No extra solving, integration, fitted k or new response type
permitted_variations: Ambient value and units within a plausible cooling scenario
Object/context and initial temperature above ambient where supplied
Derivative notation and correct option position
Algebraically equivalent representations of the same linear law can require reconsidering the sign and equilibrium; preserve method and workload

source_replay.details: Nine complete captured banks replay exactly. Easy cake q-106877 (70 F), source question 29a46a1b-3fea-5ef3-98e8-a12878014c94, is absent and rejected. Canonical bank unavailable in source.

math.details: Independent prompt-derived symbolic checks pass for all 90 control records and five batch records: one correct model, distinct choices, matching worked substitution.

variety.details: Ambient values and positions vary, but all easy generator templates are Celsius and the supported Fahrenheit cake family is missing. Moderate superficial length prediction persists despite numeric variation. No arbitrary family-size quota applied.

scope.details: Supported templates retain the source easy/moderate workload, five-equation radio contract and Newton-law setup without solving the ODE.

grading.details: Native grade_field: 107 accepted and 428 rejected choice tests across 107 records, including controlled pairs and identity-normalized delivered batch. This is radio selection; free-entry equivalence is outside its response contract.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered eleven representative records. Screenshots inspected for prompt, math, answer controls, solution and counterfactual updates; no display failure observed.

packaging.details: Exact Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 match nested dependency declarations. Deterministic replay, relocation with unrelated cwd, five-record CLI deduplication and invalid-boundary rejection pass. Package file hashes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant/irrelevant dependencies pass, but choosing the uniquely shortest equation succeeds on 10/10 turkey and 10/10 soup cases before and after delivery; thermometer I>=100 also exposes this cue. Exact easy batch has 0/5 successes for that strategy. Captured seven generated inventory records are reproduced and unaffected by this specific cue. Learner selection analysis is conditional on supplied candidate pools and positive easy-band weight; live policy/history unavailable.

findings.description: Within the recognizable turkey and soup templates, the correct model is always the uniquely shortest equation. Three-digit initial readings and two-digit ambient readings keep all distractors longer. Selecting by length bypasses reading the ambient role and applying Newton cooling. All 20 tested cases survive moderate delivery; the exact requested easy batch does not contain these templates. Thermometer instances with three-digit initial readings show the same conditional cue.
